warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0126; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines “It was two days ago.” and “It was three days ago.” are grammatical and natural for the bounded ago sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps ago to «پیش» and preserves the intended meaning across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is recognized, practiced in two guided exchanges, checked for listening/meaning, transferred, and retrieved with the answer hidden.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are short A1 alternatives with plausible surface form but clearly different meaning; none is a duplicate of the keyed answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: سارا و روبی در راه کافه درباره زمان دیدن یک فیلم و یک پیام قدیمی حرف می‌زنند.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner production stays short and controlled; no new grammar claim is added and only one lexical target is scored.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: ago recurs across recognition, guided speech, comprehension, transfer, and hidden retrieval without adding another scored lexical target.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the immediate context while preserving the same bounded sense of ago.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, construction, scenario, learner turns, choices, and final retrieval all align to the same lexical objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; perceived engagement, pacing, and difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded lexical sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns, accepted speech strings, and response options were checked for grammar and internal consistency.
Persian orthography, نیم‌فاصله usage where applicable, and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Story arc returns after 5 Lessons and the learner role changes from the prior scene.
